title: Understanding Correlation
text: To investigate correlation, consider visualizations that show the relationship between two variables. Think about how you can visually represent the connection between the amount of antibiotic and the number of colonies.

title: Choosing the Right Visualization
text: Which of the following visualizations would best show the relationship between two continuous variables?

title: Scatter Plot Insight
text: A scatter plot is useful for showing how two variables might be related. Each point represents an experiment, with the x-axis showing the amount of antibiotic and the y-axis showing the number of colonies.
